name: fig_evidence_coverage
title: Scientific evidence behind the catalogue
question: What kind of evidence supports the catalogued specifications and models, and how many of the 40 physical properties are backed by data?
model: Counts of evidence records by evidence_status and source document; property status from cryolean.coverage.property_status.
data: 667 evidence records in the catalog database (cross-checked against paper/data/e7_coverage.json); source group from each record's source fragment, equipment-gap records assigned to a manufacturer by their applies_to field; data/physics/properties.json; saved in paper/data/fig_evidence_coverage.json
caption: (a) The 667 evidence records grouped by source and coloured by evidence class: 361 manufacturer specifications, 141 experimental observations, 60 reference data, 18 textbook-model records, 13 inferred estimates and 74 records that document that a value is not stated; 419 records concern the six equipment families. (b) Status of the 40 physical compatibility properties per category, computed from the data: 25 implemented with documented data, 14 representable without equipment data, 1 representable only.
